features: Inputs: 4 BNC (AHD/analog) + 2 IP; up to 6 IP channels (up to 6 channels mixed analog + IP)
Analog input: 960H analog cameras and 720p/1080p/4K AHD cameras; recording up to 4K (3840x2160)
IP recording bandwidth 12-36 Mbps (12 Mbps default, about +6 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics: PID / LCD / PD / sound detection / camera tampering

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
4 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output; 4 audio inputs, 1 audio output (RCA)
1 x BNC spot output (704x576) for analog channels
Power consumption not recorded: urmet.de states 10 W without HDD, the user manual and urmet.com state 9.2 W (4.7 W without HDD)
Operating temperature not recorded: urmet.de states -10 to +55 C, the user manual and urmet.com state 0 to +40 C
Video outputs not recorded: urmet.de lists HDMI up to 1080p, the user manual lists HDMI up to 3840x2160
Dimensions and weight not recorded: datasheet product data (222 x 300 x 50 mm, 1.647 kg) conflicts with the spec table (300 x 53 x 227 mm, approx. 3 kg)
Named in Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023
